title: Spherical Milnor Spaces II: Projective Quotients and Higher Topological Structures
summary: We study projective and semidirect quotients of the spherical Milnor construction and develop a step-by-step lifting obstruction from their explicit spherical local sections. The resulting transition functions produce a twisted Cech 2-cocycle for any specified compatible extension with abelian kernel. When the kernel is $U(1)$ and the sign acts by complex conjugation, taking logarithms yields a twisted Dixmier--Douady obstruction under stated sheaf hypotheses. We identify its projective-operator interpretation when an additional representation is supplied, without attempting a classification…
